solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/alphabet-board-path/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1138. Alphabet Board Path

On an alphabet board, we start at position (0, 0), corresponding to character board[0][0].

Here, board = ["abcde", "fghij", "klmno", "pqrst", "uvwxy", "z"], as shown in the diagram below.

We may make the following moves:

- 'U' moves our position up one row, if the position exists on the board;
- 'D' moves our position down one row, if the position exists on the board;
- 'L' moves our position left one column, if the position exists on the board;
- 'R' moves our position right one column, if the position exists on the board;
- '!' adds the character board[r][c] at our current position (r, c) to the answer.

(Here, the only positions that exist on the board are positions with letters on them.)

Return a sequence of moves that makes our answer equal to target in the minimum number of moves. You may return any path that does so.

Example 1:

Input: target = "leet"
Output: "DDR!UURRR!!DDD!"

Example 2:

Input: target = "code"
Output: "RR!DDRR!UUL!R!"

Constraints:

    1 <= target.length <= 100
    target consists only of English lowercase letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def alphabetBoardPath(self, target: str) -> str:
        # Board layout:
        # 0: a b c d e
        # 1: f g h i j
        # 2: k l m n o
        # 3: p q r s t
        # 4: u v w x y
        # 5: z
        # Coordinates: row = index // 5, col = index % 5
        pos = {chr(ord("a") + i): (i // 5, i % 5) for i in range(26)}
        res = []
        cur_r, cur_c = 0, 0

        for ch in target:
            r, c = pos[ch]
            # Special case for 'z' at (5,0) because it has no right neighbors
            # Move up or left first to avoid invalid positions
            # Move up first if needed
            while cur_r > r:
                res.append("U")
                cur_r -= 1
            # Move left if needed
            while cur_c > c:
                res.append("L")
                cur_c -= 1
            # Move down if needed
            while cur_r < r:
                res.append("D")
                cur_r += 1
            # Move right if needed
            while cur_c < c:
                res.append("R")
                cur_c += 1
            res.append("!")
        return "".join(res)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.alphabetBoardPath("leet"))  # "DDR!UURRR!!DDD!"
print(sol.alphabetBoardPath("code"))  # "RR!DDRR!UUL!R!"

assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("leet") == "DDR!UURRR!!DDD!"
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("code") == "RR!DDRR!UUL!R!"

assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("a") == "!"
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("z") == "DDDDD!"
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("az") == "!DDDDD!"
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("za") == "DDDDD!UUUUU!"
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("zzzzzzzzzz") == "DDDDD!!!!!!!!!!"
assert (
    sol.alphabetBoardPath("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
    == "!R!R!R!R!LLLLD!R!R!R!R!LLLLD!R!R!R!R!LLLLD!R!R!R!R!LLLLD!R!R!R!R!LLLLD!"
)
assert (
    sol.alphabetBoardPath("zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba")
    == "DDDDD!URRRR!L!L!L!L!URRRR!L!L!L!L!URRRR!L!L!L!L!URRRR!L!L!L!L!URRRR!L!L!L!L!"
)
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("mmmmmmmmmm") == "DDRR!!!!!!!!!!"
assert (
    sol.alphabetBoardPath("a" * 100)
    == "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"
)
assert (
    sol.alphabetBoardPath("z" * 100)
    == "DDDDD!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"
)
assert sol.alphabetBoardPath("azbycx") == "!DDDDD!UUUUUR!DDDDRRR!UUUULL!DDDDR!"
assert (
    sol.alphabetBoardPath("qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm")
    == "DDDR!DR!UUUURR!LLDDD!RR!D!LLLL!UUURRR!DR!LLLLD!UUU!DDDRRR!UUU!LLLD!R!R!RR!LLLLD!R!LDDD!URRR!UUUUL!LDDDD!UUUU!DDRR!L!"
)
